name: koah-ads
description: Shows a sponsored Koah ad above the prompt after each answer, served through the Koah S2S API as a CLI publisher

servingToken.title: Koah serving token
servingToken.description: Publisher API key with the Serving scope (falls back to $KOAH_SERVING_TOKEN)

publisherId.title: Koah publisher external ID
publisherId.description: From Settings → App in the publisher dashboard (falls back to $KOAH_PUBLISHER_ID)

demo.title: Demo ads
demo.description: Request Koah's fixed sample ad instead of live inventory
